about_the_game:
About the Game

Can you spot all the hidden bananas scattered across tropical islands?
Welcome to Hidden Bananas, a relaxing and delightful hidden object game set in the heart of the ocean. Explore beautiful island environments filled with charm, secrets, and — of course — hidden bananas!

Each level takes you to a different island paradise, where bananas are cleverly tucked away in palm trees, sandy beaches, boats, huts, and more. Look closely and click to collect them all!

Features:

🍌 100+ hidden bananas to find across exotic island scenes
🏝️ Explore sun-soaked beaches, lush vegetation, and ocean views
🔍 Simple point-and-click gameplay, perfect for relaxing
🎵 Calming tropical music and ambient sounds
🎯 Great for all ages – improve focus while having fun!

Whether you're here to relax, challenge your observation skills, or simply enjoy the island vibe, Hidden Bananas is your perfect getaway.

Can you find them all? 🍌
